candidate_training: Each candidate uses the inherited base train partition, incident-v2 train families and inherited v3 stress train partition.
validation_acceptance: no base-validation H1, H3 or H5 regression greater than two percent
incident-v2 validation geometric H1/H3/H5 error improves by at least five percent with no individual-horizon regression
stress-validation geometric H1/H3/H5 error does not regress and is included in the selection score
latent standard deviation is at least 0.02, effective rank is at least 4.0 and action sensitivity is at least 0.005
the serialized candidate fits the deployed PJE1 limits of at most 128 latent and 256 hidden units
selection: Among validation-accepted candidates, select the lowest weighted geometric ratio with incident-v2 validation counted twice. If none pass, retain the lowest-score candidate only for an honest final diagnostic; it is not promotion eligible.
final_promotion: no base-test H1, H3 or H5 regression greater than two percent
incident-v2 test geometric H1/H3/H5 error improves by at least five percent
incident-v2 test false negatives do not increase
stress-test false negatives do not increase
registered-OOD false negatives do not increase
incident-v2, stress and OOD false-positive rates each remain within two percentage points of the baseline
selected validation anti-collapse variance ratio remains at least 0.10
unchanged_authority: A promoted PJE1 artifact may add caution only in a digest-bound simulation session. It cannot grant a permit, approve a command or invoke an adapter.
